why: Names the placode as origin of hair matrix cells, WNT/EDA specification and dermal condensate signalling during invagination, matching the intended answer.
Covers angiogenesis, scarless healing, fibroblast maintenance and neurovascular development, all four intended roles.
Gives WNT2, COL1A1/ECM late, SFRP1 early, plus CDKN1A, IL1R1 and POSTN; only the IL6 downregulation is omitted.
Dermal location with LYVE1+ macrophage co-location is accurate; omitting the TML co-location is a permitted partial.
ECM/collagen deposition late, growth and differentiation early, and acquisition of a pro-inflammatory/senescence profile are all conveyed.
TREM2 plus the microglia-like P2RY12/CX3CR1/OLFML3 profile is exactly the intended panel.
Reports both WNT2+ fibroblast co-location at 6-8 PCW and Schwann cell co-location in ME1.
States sprouting angiogenesis and Schwann cell interaction in synapse formation and axon guidance, the two intended functions.
Identifies the Dc as FOXD1+SOX2+ via mouse orthologues, the key intended marker pair.
Dermal compartment from 12 PCW abutting the epithelial hair placode matches the intended answer.
Conveys aggregation from pre-Dc cells and dermal-epidermal crosstalk in hair follicle development; omission of FAM3C/EFNB1 migration detail is a partial, not an error.
Names SHH and WNT10B as known hair matrix markers, correctly avoiding the extracellular-matrix sense.
Reports chemotaxis genes CXCL14 and CD24 and the inferred Treg accumulation and immune protection role.
Gives LYVE1 and GAS6 and correctly notes the body text offers no fuller marker panel.
